text: شهدت المباراة بين Kingsmoor FC و Westport Albion منافسة قوية انتهت بتعادل 3-3. سجّل Viktor Quinlan هدفين لفريقه، واحد بركلة جزاء وآخر بعد تمريرة مدروسة، مما يعكس مهارته وتأثيره الكبير في اللعب [#152][#222]. من ناحية أخرى، رد Rafael Delacroix بهدفين متتالين لفريق Westport Albion، بعد هجمات سريعة ومتسلسلة من التمريرات المباشرة التي ساعدت الفريق على التعادل قبل نهاية الشوط الأول [#401][#553]. سيطر Kingsmoor على الكرة قليلاً بنسبة 51.5% وكانت دقة تمريراته أعلى، وهذا ساعده على خلق فرص من خلال اللعب العرضي وتمريرات عرضية. مع طرد Felix Barros رقم 81 دقيقة، استغل Kingsmoor الفرصة ليسجل Luca Iversen هدف التعادل في الدقيقة 82، مما أضاف المزيد من الإثارة للمباراة [#1495][#1516].

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in ar

- Viktor Quinlan scored 2 goals with an xG of 0.76 (penalty) and 0.197 respectively, contributing significantly to Kingsmoor FC's score [#152, #222].
- Rafael Delacroix scored twice for Westport Albion with high xG of 0.797 and 0.992, equalizing their goals to 2 by the 30th minute [#401, #553].
- Both teams had equal big chances (3 each), but Westport Albion had more shots (18 vs 10) and shots on target (11 vs 3) showing offensive dominance [team_stats].
- Kingsmoor FC had slight possession advantage at 51.5% and higher pass accuracy at 81.3% compared to 79.3% for Westport Albion [team_stats].
- A red card was issued to Felix Barros of Kingsmoor FC at 81', potentially impacting the game's dynamics before Luca Iversen's 82' goal for Kingsmoor FC [#1495, #1516].

- Kingsmoor FC's early goals reflect their 4-4-2 formation leveraging wide, crossing play with build-up from regains. The second goal at 12' involved a patient multi-pass sequence (8 passes in 26.7 seconds) starting from a ball regain, showing their ability to exploit wide areas and create space for their forwards, with Viktor Quinlan finishing after a medium assist by Felix Duarte [#222].
- Westport Albion, also in a 4-4-2 but playing direct, vertical passing, responded with quick, vertical sequences following regains to exploit gaps, as seen in both goals by Rafael Delacroix at 22' and 30'. These goals arose from swift, direct passing moves (7 passes in 25.8 seconds and 10 passes in 40.3 seconds respectively) culminating in close-range finishes and a cross, reflecting their style [#401, #553].
- Tactical changes highlight the contrasting styles: Kingsmoor increased pressing intensity and directness from 65' onwards, chasing the game, likely raising their line height and tempo to regain control and generate chances [#1187]. Conversely, Westport Albion dropped deeper and slowed the tempo after 79', reducing pressing and line height to protect the lead, indicating a transition from attacking to a defensive, counter-press resistant stance [#1459].
- The late Kingsmoor goal at 82' came from a quick attacking move after a ball regain with just two passes in around 9 seconds, including a cross assist by Mason Morales, reinforcing their tactical identity centered on wide crossing and taking advantage of numerical or positional superiority, particularly significant following Westport Albion’s red card [#1516, #1495].
